summary: CC BY 4.0 and local complexity/dependency/duplicate checks pass, but the USDZ has no separable fixed frame. The apparent outer frame is part of the same connected leaf mesh. The other three components are localized lever/plate geometry. No truthful Frame assignment exists for the required 5.0 recipe.

component_review.2: Complete four-panel leaf and its outer border; the central panel fills the opening and is one connected component.
component_review.0_1_3: Localized lever/plate hardware on the same edge; no full-height, independent frame or hinge fitting.

limits: This is an asset-shape filter failure for the current B1 corpus, not a license or GPU/runtime failure.
Adding a separately sourced frame would be a new composite asset and require its own provenance and preparation scope. The original USDZ and inspection attempt are preserved.
